text:
**Wednesday**, and today is the math quiz on lessons 5-1 to 5-4 and long division. Take your time on each problem and check the ones you can. The Book Fair breakfast runs 7:00 to 8:00, and Science hands out the weather journals today. Ask when yours is due.

Friday is the Costume Parade, with owl pellets in Science. Tonight, read a chapter of The Lemonade Crime: that quiz and the Wordly Wise quiz land sometime this week.
